packageRules.description: Patch-level updates on NuGet/npm are auto-merged once CI is green — low blast radius, keeps the PR queue from piling up. Anything minor/major still needs a human look.
Group all Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.* / Npgsql.* packages into one PR instead of one per package — they're versioned together in practice and reviewing five near-identical PRs adds no signal.

Terraform provider/module bumps reviewed manually — a provider version bump can change resource behavior (see ArkCloudInfra's own azurerm zip_deploy_file bug, found via a real provider issue). Never auto-merge infrastructure.
